paragraphs: Glacier makes sorting robots for recycling plants, pairing computer vision with mechanical picking to pull more material off the line. The company sells to two audiences at once: the material recovery facilities that run those lines, and consumer brands that want to know what becomes of their packaging.

The robots are compact and built to recover plastics, film and flexibles, paper, OCC, and metals. Behind the picking sit vision models the company says were trained on billions of real recycling images. Operators follow the results on dashboards that report down to the individual item.

Glacier says its robots are built specifically for material recovery facilities, with AI giving visibility at the item level. The company frames its purpose as a world where nothing valuable ends up in a landfill. It also says the team is growing and that it is hiring across engineering, operations, and field support.

quote.text: Our mission is simple: end waste by ensuring nothing valuable ends up in a landfill.
